title: AC Shadows patch no longer working as of 1.0.2 update
body:
The patch worked on 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 versions of the game, but it appears to no longer work for the 1.0.2 version. I have confirmed that Pyroveil is being properly loaded, but the game freezes before it can open the main menu - just like it does without the patch.

I can only assume that the `opStringSearch` hashes have changed, but I don't have the expertise to find out where they were derived from originally or what to update them to.
author: ekgame

comments.body: I can confirm it's broken again here on 1.0.2
Yes this is broken again on version 1.0.2
Game changed their shader hashes. Updated. Remember to delete vkd3d-proton.cache and vkd3d-proton.cache.write before restarting.

Thanks Hans. This game is bound to receive many updates in the coming weeks. Would you mind leaving some pointers, even if brief and vague, on how to find offending shaders and their hashes, so that the community can update Pyroveil config independently, in case you are unavailable? This sounds like an easy procedure with the right tooling, but I couldn't find a starting point to learn and investigate this on my own.

> Where to delete vkd3d-proton.cache and vkd3d-proton.cache.write

Next to application .exe. If it's not there it should be fine.

> Would you mind leaving some pointers, even if brief and vague, on how to find offending shaders and their hashes, so that the community can update Pyroveil config independently, in case you are unavailable?

It's not intended for end users to do this, but the general idea is to use a debug build of Proton Experimental, run VKD3D_CONFIG=breadcrumbs to find which shader is hanging, then looking at the shader hash which caused the hang, then just add that hash to the config.

> Next to application .exe. If it's not there it should be fine.

I couldn't find these files in the root directory of the game. And it still froze. But I cleared the cache in steam itself, and cleaned the cache in my documents where the game folder. That helped.

i was able to find the `vkd3d-proton.cache` 
here:
```bash
<dir to steam games>/SteamLibrary/steamapps/common/Assassin\'s\ Creed\ Shadows/
```
i my case:
```bash
find /mnt/games/SteamLibrary -name "vkd3d-proton*"
```

after restarting the game `vkd3d-proton.cache.write` showed up in the same dir ... 

... i updated my pyroveil.json file with the new configs values and the game works again :) 

ty @HansKristian-Work

title: Monster Hunter Wilds Benchmark Testing
body:
Just as a fun experiment I ran the benchmark (3424520) with the following file

```
{
	"version": 1,
	"type": "pyroveil",
	"matches": [
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 5364, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } },
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 5365, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } },
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 5269, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } },
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 5298, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } },
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 5270, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } },
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 26, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } },
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 27, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } },
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 17, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } },
		{ "spirvExecutionModel": 5283, "action": { "glsl-roundtrip": true } }
	]
}
```

and not only does the compilation take a fraction of the time it also has decently improved performance.

Sadly it didn't magically fix the nvidia vertex glitching for the title, but it was drastic enough of an improvement that I wanted to report it.
author: warcode

comments.body: This looks like complete nonsense to me. Most of those values are bogus or disable mesh/task which is not used by MHW. The only thing the layer will do is to force-disable VK_NV_raw_access_chains, which should be a small detriment, not win.
Yes, I apologize. Drunk weekend post. Performance gains were from something completely unrelated.
